title: New tax year — check your Contribution Limits
body: IRS 401(k), HSA, and IRA limits change every year. Revisit Contribution Limits to make sure the numbers you're planning around are still current.
label: Open Contribution Limits

title: Haven't backed up in a while?
body: Everything you enter stays only in this browser. Clearing site data — or losing the device — can wipe it without warning. A Profile Manager export takes a few seconds.
label: Open Profile Manager

title: Notifications are here
body: This bell shows updates from the FireNate team, plus milestones you cross on your own — like paying off a debt or hitting a savings goal — computed right in your browser.

title: Emergency Fund: fully funded
body: You've saved enough to cover your target months of expenses — a real safety net, not just a number on a page. Nice work.
label: Open Emergency Fund

title: Scheduled example — hidden until Sep 15, 9am
body: "date" can carry a time ("YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM"), not just a day — this entry stays completely out of the list, badge count, and everything else until that moment actually arrives. A plain "YYYY-MM-DD" still just means "visible as soon as that day starts," same as every other example here.
